To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) α-Mg particles in β-Li phase could be formed in duplex Mg-6% Li and Mg-6Li-6Zn-1Y alloys by ageing process.

the precipitation and coagulation process of α-Mag particles could occur in the β-Li phases during the ageing process of both two alloys, and the age-soften response of β-Lis in Mg-6Li-6Zn-1Y alloy is much more profound.
the precipitation and the coarsening of α-Mg in β-Li phase occurred during ageing process, and the α-Mg precipitated in β-Li could be the source of cracks in duplex structured Mg-LixLi1-x alloys.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the natural ageing responses of duplex Mg-Li based alloy.
the microstructural evolution of duplex Mg-Li based alloy during natural ageing.
the natural ageing responses of duplex structures in Mg-Li based alloy, which could provide some useful information for the design of Mg-based alloys.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for Mg-Li based alloy, natural ageing response of β-L phase would be the main factor that determines the macro mechanical properties of the material.

, the ageing response of duplex structured Mg alloys is a complicated process, in which the age-hardening response in α-Mg phases and the age-soften response of β-Lig phases should be considered simultaneously.
the age-soften phenomenon in terms of micro hardness was not consistent with that in terms of macro mechanical properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the age-hardening responses of α-Mg and age-softening responses of β-Li could be simultaneously maintained for the duplex structured Mg-8.2%Li-1.2%Mn alloy.
the ageing responses of α-Mg and Li phases in Mg-Li based alloy were significantly dependent on the alloy composition.
the ageing-softening responses of β-Li and α-Mg phases should be taken into account in the design of Mg-Li based alloy products.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ageing responses of duplex Mg-Li based alloy could be significantly modified by adding Zn and Y.
the ageing responses of duplex Mg-Li based alloy are more complicated than that of single phase Mg-Li alloy.
a certain amount of Zn atoms could be beneficial to suppress the age-hardening of β-Li phase, but detrimental to the age-hardening response in α-Mg phase.
